item.text: {"winner":"B","confidence":"high","summary":"B is the safer merge because it implements the requested convenience API with established multipart buffering while avoiding A’s expressly out-of-scope retry-transport and RawClient behavior changes. Both patches improperly duplicate FilesService.Add instead of routing through it, but B’s defect is substantially easier to correct.","reasons":["Both implementations use multipartbody.NewFile with field \"file\", preserve the public Add signature, validate required inputs, and produce a replayable buffered body.","Both violate the explicit requirement to route Upload through FilesService.Add; each repeats its option handling, POST construction, response decoding, and missing-data error logic.","A additionally changes RawClient.Do, seekable-body ownership, content-length calculation, and retry behavior even though the contract explicitly forbids refactoring unrelated request/retry machinery and requires Add behavior to remain unchanged.","A’s RawClient GetBody closure returns repeated wrappers around the same mutable io.ReadSeeker rather than independent readers, introducing fragile shared-position semantics beyond the upload fix. That machinery is unnecessary because multipartbody.NewFile already supplies a replayable body for Upload.Viewing it as part of this patch would materially increase review risk and API-semantic surface area more than A’s stronger tests justify. [invalid token removed]B is narrowly scoped and follows the existing buffering mechanism; its retry test also hides the source reader’s concrete type, demonstrating that replayability comes from multipart encoding rather than the original reader."],"risks_a":["Upload duplicates Add instead of delegating to it.","The RawClient change expands scope and changes caller/body ownership and retry semantics contrary to the frozen contract.","The shared seekable reader used by GetBody may be unsafe if replay bodies overlap or are requested more than once independently. [invalid token removed]No test covers source-reader failure propagation."],"risks_b":["Upload duplicates Add instead of delegating to it, risking future divergence in options, request construction, decoding, or errors.","Tests omit required empty-filename, nil-content, and source-reader-error cases.","The retry test checks attempts and success but does not verify that the multipart filename and content are present on the retried request. [invalid token removed]Comments and changelog inaccurately describe *os.File as non-seekable and expose excessive net/http implementation detail."]}
